items: Grown-up creatures are now far stronger than young ones (about three and a half times), so evolving your animals to adult really pays, and the wild adults far from home hit harder
Young creatures are a little gentler, and young and adults take fewer 💌s to win over (7 and 14, from 9 and 18)
Evolving now costs 3 berries to young and 8 to adult (it was 4 and 4)
Add ?tuning=pre-overnight to the link to play the balance as it was before tonight
